research.name: Noisedeck
research.note: Browser-based shader video synthesizer where you chain generator and filter effects or write programs in a DSL and export video.

effects: Chained shader effect pipeline (perlin to adjust) with per-parameter controls rendering live to a canvas
Programmable DSL for composing shader programs

unverified: The shader engine noisemaker is public at github.com/noisefactorllc/noisemaker (MIT) and the about page mentions an open source core; no public repository for the Noisedeck app itself was found.
lastUpdated is the newest commit to the noisemaker engine repository; it was not confirmed that this change is deployed in the app.
